scope: Generated foliage lamina geometry: remove perfectly-planar leaf-card normal response while preserving existing tree construction, two-sided topology, morphology diversity and LOD identity.

sourceFinding.problem: The generated GM_LeafSpray_A/B/C masters use contiguous eight-vertex groups made from two coincident copies of a four-vertex planar diamond lamina. Morphology diversity rotates/scales those groups but does not add macro curvature, so every leaf can retain a synchronized planar BRDF response under grazing sun even when cluster silhouettes differ.
evidence: QualityBlockTreeDetailUpgrade.BuildLeafSprayMesh constructs tip/right/base/left planar front vertices plus coincident reversed back vertices.
QualityBlockFoliageMorphologyVariationUpgrade preserves source triangle/UV topology and applies bounded per-leaf transform variation.
NewTown/FoliageTransmission provides physically constrained material-side normal/Fresnel/transmission behavior, but material micro-normal cannot replace missing macro lamina curvature.

geometry: Added QualityBlockFoliageLaminaGeometryUpgrade with a deterministic shallow V-fold around the existing tip-to-base midrib diagonal.
Fold depth is 8.5-15.5% of lamina half-width; right/left depth receives bounded deterministic variation.
Added +/-3.5% longitudinal side asymmetry and +/-1.8% tip/base lateral asymmetry without moving LeafCluster transforms or woody construction.
Preserved the canonical eight-vertex/twelve-index two-sided topology and exact front/back positional coincidence, so existing material, shadow and morphology paths remain compatible.
Added idempotence: already-folded meshes are detected and not folded repeatedly.
pipelineBinding: Registered a benchmark-scene save binding. When upstream tree-detail generation recreates planar base sprays and saves the benchmark scene, the base meshes are folded before downstream morphology regeneration.
Derived morphology variants generated from folded bases inherit the physical lamina construction; existing derived variants are also opportunistically converged on scene save.
Explicit Build Folded Foliage Lamina Geometry menu path persists morphology renderer assignments and mesh assets.
qa: Added foliage_lamina_geometry_contract.json with biological assembly, dimensions, material/geometry ownership, installation boundaries, LOD policy, canonical critical-defect IDs and native-4K review targets.
Added QualityBlockFoliageLaminaGeometryQA formal pre-cull binding for QA4K_ and QAPreparedTemporal_ 3840x2160 targets.
QA requires all three base sprays plus twelve derived variants, canonical topology, coincident front/back vertices, complete UV/normals/tangents and every lamina inside the 3-28 degree fold window.
QA cross-checks critical defect IDs against visual_fidelity_gate.json and enforces zero automatic Visual Fidelity points.
implementation.lookdev: Added Assets/QA/lookdev/foliage_lamina_geometry_lookdev.svg contrasting rejected planar normal response with the required shallow fold and documenting geometry-vs-material ownership. It is explicitly non-render evidence.

selfAudit: Initial explicit build path did not persist scene renderer assignments after morphology ApplyToOpenScene; fixed by marking/saving the active scene before final AssetDatabase save.
Initial fold comment stated an overly broad millimetre range; replaced with a scale-relative statement rather than claiming unverified absolute dimensions.
Lookdev existed but was not contract-bound; contract and QA were tightened so the illustration must exist and must remain non-render evidence.

verification.repositoryCompare: startHead -> preRecordHead is ahead by 7, behind by 0; merge base remains startHead

expectedVisualScoreImpact.vegetationNaturalComplexity: positive candidate: macro leaf normals are no longer forced planar, reducing card-like synchronized highlights; must be confirmed from actual hero/oblique/grazing pixels
expectedVisualScoreImpact.lightingShadowsReflections: positive candidate: leaf-facing normals and dapple response become geometry-derived rather than entirely planar; no points until actual render
expectedVisualScoreImpact.temporalLodAliasing: mixed candidate: de-synchronized normals can reduce coherent flash but extra angular variation can increase shimmer; temporal/subpixel_grazing is mandatory
